headline: Project-based excellence
shortBio: I'm an eclectic developer always seeking to learn new things. I move from project to project in pursuit of new skills, and if there is room for growth, I'm in.
aboutParagraphs: I shifted into software development after building a foundation in operations-heavy project environments. That transition sharpened my interest in systems thinking, practical automation, and quality-focused delivery.

Today I work as an Ansible automation engineer at Dell, with responsibilities centered on security and lifecycle maintenance. Because the role is NDA-constrained, I share outcomes and process strengths publicly instead of sensitive implementation details.

My portfolio spans automation, full-stack applications, and game-development experiments. Across all of them, the through-line is the same: learn fast, solve real problems, and leave systems more reliable than I found them.
